name: Takara Sushi (Logan) Grilled Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki Rice Bowl & Udon Noodle Soup
whyItWorks: Thick, soft wheat udon noodles in clear dashi broth or grilled chicken/salmon teriyaki over steamed white rice—warm, cooked, and soothing on rough gut days.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki with steamed white rice (skip the raw cabbage side salad) or the plain Chicken/Nabeyaki Udon (tempura on the side).
watchOuts: Skip the raw cabbage salad with citrus/ginger dressing
